name: c975l/gallery-bundle
description: Symfony bundle providing photo galleries on the c975L core — categories and medias (photos and videos from any platform UiBundle declares), with batch upload, automatic thumb/medium/highres derivatives and a public viewer.

suggest.ext-exif: Reads a photo's capture date to discriminate the urls of a batch uploaded under one title root - without it, the filename and the batch rank are used instead

scripts.mess: phpmd src text phpmd.xml.dist --ignore-errors-on-exit --report-file .phpmd-report.log; s=$?; grep -E "^(/|[[:space:]]*-)" .phpmd-report.log; n=$(grep -c "Unexpected token" .phpmd-report.log); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then echo "phpmd analysed nothing in $n file(s): PDepend cannot parse them"; fi; exit $s
scripts.lizard-nloc: find src -name '*.php' ! -name '*CrudController.php' ! -name '*Type.php' | xargs lizard -l php -T nloc=99 -C 999 -a 999 -w

scripts-descriptions.audit-deps: Avis de sécurité Packagist sur les dépendances résolues (OWASP A06) - les paquets abandonnés sont signalés, sans faire échouer
scripts-descriptions.qa: Tous les contrôles de la CI, dans l'ordre - voir bin/ci.sh pour les rejouer sur des dépendances fraîches
